title: Using the Internet
about: Collocations for everyday internet use: looking for information online, like do a web search, refine your search and evaluate sites critically, and keeping your computer and files safe, like install anti-virus software, open an attachment and back up your files.

items.pattern: a good / the best place to start (is sth / is by + -ing) · noun + to-infinitive
items.meaning: the most useful thing to look at or do first
items.uk: з чого варто почати; гарна відправна точка
items.example: If you want to trace your family history, **a good place to start** is your grandparents' old photos and letters.
more: The town's tourist website is **a good place to start** if you're looking for somewhere cheap to stay.
Not sure which washing machine to buy? **The best place to start** is the reviews from other buyers.
items.watchOut: «Почни з того, що…» — start by + -ing: start by reading the reviews, а не start from reading. Start from частіше кажуть про місце чи точку відліку: start from the beginning.

items.pattern: make a note of sth · verb + noun + of · make a mental note · take notes (на уроці, лекції)
items.meaning: write something down so that you remember it
items.example: I **made a note of** the hotel's phone number in case we got lost.
more: Can you **make a note of** what we need from the supermarket?
The receptionist told me to **make a note of** the date of my next appointment.
items.watchOut: «Записати, щоб не забути» — make a note of sth або write sth down, не do a note. А «конспектувати» на уроці чи лекції — take notes.

items.pattern: do a (web / quick / Google) search · verb + noun · search (online) for sth
items.meaning: look for information on the internet by typing words into a search engine
items.example: I **did a quick web search** and found a cheaper flight.
more: She **did a web search** for the restaurant and found its menu online.
Don't **do a web search** for your symptoms the night before a doctor's appointment: it'll only scare you.
items.watchOut: «В інтернеті» — on the internet або online, не in the internet. «Шукати щось» — search for sth: search for a cheap hotel. Без for (search the hotel) — це «обшукати готель».

items.pattern: online / free / useful resources · adjective + noun · a (useful) resource for sb
items.meaning: useful material on the internet, such as articles, videos and exercises, that helps you learn or do something
items.example: Our school's website links to some brilliant **online resources** for maths homework.
more: The museum has great **online resources**, including videos and quizzes for kids.
My grandma learnt to use her smartphone with the help of **online resources** from the library.
items.watchOut: Не плутай resource і source. Resource — корисний матеріал (відео, вправи, статті): a useful resource. Source — джерело, звідки взялася інформація: always check the source.

items.pattern: hints and tips (on / for sth) · noun + and + noun, fixed order · useful / handy tips
items.meaning: short pieces of practical advice that help you do something better
items.example: The seed packet has **hints and tips** on growing tomatoes on a balcony.
more: My aunt's blog is full of **hints and tips** for cooking on a budget.
The airline's website gives **hints and tips** on packing light.
items.watchOut: «Порада» — a tip або a piece of advice. Advice незлічуване: some advice, не advices. Порядок у парі сталий: hints and tips.

items.pattern: refine / narrow (down) your search · verb + noun · refine your search by price / by adding a word
items.meaning: make a search more exact, for example by adding words or changing the settings, so you get fewer, better results
items.example: There were over a thousand flats, but when I **refined my search** to ones with a garden, only six were left.
more: Type the name of your town too, to **refine your search**.
The website lets you **refine your search** by price, so you don't waste time on expensive hotels.
items.watchOut: «Уточнити пошук» — refine your search або narrow (down) your search, не clarify your search (clarify — пояснити, з'ясувати) і не specify your search.

items.pattern: evaluate sth critically / critically evaluate sth · verb + adverb · evaluate a website / information / sources
items.meaning: think carefully about whether information is true and can be trusted
items.example: Teach your children to **critically evaluate** what they read online, not just believe it.
more: When you read health advice online, **evaluate it critically**: who wrote it, and when?
A good journalist **critically evaluates** every source.
items.watchOut: «Оцінювати» в сенсі «чи можна цьому вірити» — evaluate або assess, не estimate (estimate — приблизно підрахувати: estimate the cost) і не appreciate (цінувати).

items.pattern: subscribe to a journal / magazine / newsletter / channel · verb + to + noun · a subscription (to sth)
items.meaning: pay or sign up to receive something regularly, such as a magazine, a newsletter or the videos from a channel
items.example: My sister is a nurse, and she **subscribes to two online medical journals**.
more: I **subscribe to** a cooking magazine, and a new issue arrives every month.
My son **subscribes to** a dozen cooking channels and now makes dinner every Friday.
items.watchOut: «Підписатися на» — subscribe to, не subscribe on. Subscribe — про підписку чи передплату; «підписати документ» — sign.

items.pattern: search (sth) by keyword / name / date · verb + by + noun · a keyword search
items.meaning: find something by typing one important word that describes what you're looking for
items.example: On the recipe site you can **search by keyword**, so I typed 'lentils'.
more: The library catalogue lets you **search by keyword** or by author.
I couldn't remember the title of the song, so I **searched by keyword**: 'rain' and 'summer'.
items.watchOut: «За ключовим словом» — by keyword, як і search by name, search by date. Не search after keyword.

items.pattern: back issues of a magazine / newspaper / journal · adjective + noun · a back issue · also back numbers
items.meaning: earlier copies of a magazine, newspaper or journal, not the newest one
items.example: The local paper has put its **back issues** online, and I found an article about my grandparents' wedding.
more: The café has a pile of **back issues** of travel magazines for customers to read.
My dad keeps every **back issue** of his football magazine in the attic.
items.watchOut: «Номер журналу» — an issue, не a number (back numbers трапляється, але рідше). Свіжий номер — the latest issue, а back issues — усі попередні.

items.pattern: copy and paste sth (into sth) · verb + and + verb, fixed order · also cut and paste
items.meaning: copy words or a picture from one place and put exactly the same thing somewhere else on a computer or phone
items.example: I **copied and pasted** the address into a message and sent it to my mum.
more: **Copy and paste** the tracking number into the box, and you'll see where your parcel is.
Teachers can tell when you've **copied and pasted** your homework from a website.
items.watchOut: «Вставити» скопійований текст — paste, не insert (insert — вставити щось усередину: insert your card). Порядок сталий: copy and paste.

items.pattern: keep a record of sth · verb + noun + of · keep records · also keep a note of sth
items.meaning: write information down and keep it, so you can check it later
items.example: I **keep a record of** everything I spend, so I know where my money goes.
more: Ask your landlord for a receipt and **keep a record of** every payment.
The doctor asked me to **keep a record of** when my headaches start.
items.watchOut: «Вести облік, записувати» — keep a record of sth, не lead a record. Іменник record має наголос на першому складі /ˈrekɔːd/, а дієслово to record — на другому /rɪˈkɔːd/.

items.pattern: install / run anti-virus software · verb + noun · an anti-virus program
items.meaning: put a program on your computer or phone that protects it from viruses
items.example: The first thing I did with my new laptop was **install anti-virus software**.
more: My son **installed anti-virus software** on Grandma's computer after she clicked on a strange link.
Do I need to **install anti-virus software** on my phone too?
items.watchOut: Software незлічуване: anti-virus software, не softwares і не an anti-virus software. Якщо потрібне злічуване слово — an anti-virus program. «Встановити програму» — install, не establish (establish — заснувати).

items.pattern: block / filter spam · verb + noun · block a number / unwanted emails
items.meaning: stop unwanted emails, usually adverts or tricks, from getting to you
items.example: Since I changed my email settings, the filter **blocks spam** before I ever see it.
more: Our office email **blocks spam**, but the odd advert still gets through.
I **blocked** the number that kept sending me texts about a 'free prize'.
items.watchOut: Spam незлічуване: a lot of spam, не spams. Один такий лист — a spam email або junk email.

items.pattern: update your apps / software / anti-virus program (regularly) · verb + noun + adverb · an update · keep sth up to date
items.meaning: put the newest version of a program on your device often, so it works well and stays safe
items.example: If you **regularly update** your phone, it's much harder for viruses to get in.
more: My laptop **updates** itself overnight, so it's ready in the morning.
Grandad never **updates** anything, so his tablet is years behind.
items.watchOut: «Оновити програму» — update, не renew (renew — подовжити термін: renew your passport, renew a subscription). Refresh — оновити сторінку, а не встановити нову версію.

items.pattern: click (on) a link / a button / an icon · verb + on + noun · tap a link (on a phone)
items.meaning: press the mouse button or touch the screen to open a link
items.example: **Click on the link** in the email to confirm your booking.
more: I **clicked on a link** to a news story, but it took me to a page full of adverts.
If you **click on** the photo of the jacket, you can see it in other colours.
items.watchOut: «Посилання» — a link, не a reference. «Натиснути на посилання» — click (on) a link, а на телефоні — tap a link; не push a link.

items.pattern: open / send / download an attachment · verb + noun · attach a file to an email
items.meaning: look at a file, such as a photo or a document, that someone sent with an email
items.example: Grandma **opened the attachment** and saw the first photos of her new grandson.
more: I **opened the attachment**, but it was just a blank page.
Be careful: a fake invoice **attachment** can install a virus when you **open** it.
items.watchOut: «Вкладення» в листі — an attachment, не an investment (це вкладення грошей). «Прикріпити файл» — attach a file to an email, з прийменником to.

items.pattern: download (free) apps / applications / a file / music · verb + noun · ↔ upload
items.meaning: copy a program or file from the internet onto your phone or computer
items.example: My son **downloads free apps** all the time, and half of them are full of adverts.
more: Can you **download** your boarding pass to your phone?
The concert tickets are on my phone: I **downloaded** them last night.
items.watchOut: Українське «завантажити» буває і download, і upload. Download — з інтернету на свій пристрій (download an app), upload — зі свого пристрою в інтернет (upload a photo to Instagram).

items.pattern: hack into sb's computer / account / email · verb + into + noun · hack an account · be hacked · a hacker
items.meaning: get into someone's computer or account without permission, usually to steal information
items.example: Someone **hacked into** my sister's email and sent strange messages to all her friends.
more: If you use the same password everywhere, it's easier for someone to **hack into** all your accounts.
My cousin's gaming account **was hacked**, and he lost everything he'd won.
items.watchOut: «Зламати акаунт» — hack (into) an account або my account was hacked, не break an account: break — зламати фізично (break your phone). Break into теж кажуть про комп'ютерні системи, але найчастіше — про будинок чи машину.

items.pattern: back up your files / data / photos · back sth up · a backup (noun)
items.meaning: make a copy of your files and keep it somewhere safe, in case you lose them
items.example: I **back up my photos** every month, because I don't want to lose pictures of the kids.
more: My laptop reminds me to **back up** my files every Friday.
Luckily, there was a **backup** of my CV in my email.
items.watchOut: Дієслово — back up, два слова: back up your files, back them up (займенник посередині). Іменник — a backup, одне слово: make a backup. Save up — це «відкладати гроші», а не «зберегти копію».

items.pattern: upload files / photos / videos (to a website / the cloud) · verb + noun + to · ↔ download
items.meaning: copy files from your phone or computer to a website or to storage on the internet
items.uk: завантажити (вивантажити) файли в інтернет, у хмару
items.example: I **uploaded all our holiday photos** to a shared album so the whole family could see them.
more: The school asked us to **upload** the homework to its website by Friday.
My video took ages to **upload** because the hotel wifi was so slow.
items.watchOut: Upload — зі свого пристрою в інтернет: upload photos to a website. Прийменник — to (або onto), не in. Протилежне — download.

items.pattern: cloud storage · noun + noun · a cloud storage system / service · in the cloud
items.meaning: keeping your files on the internet, not on your own device, so you can open them from anywhere
items.example: With **cloud storage**, I can open my documents at work, at home or on the train.
more: All our wedding videos are **in the cloud**, so we can watch them on the TV.
My laptop is old, but with **cloud storage** I don't worry about it breaking.
items.watchOut: «У хмарі» — in the cloud, з артиклем the: my photos are in the cloud. Storage незлічуване: cloud storage, без артикля; але a cloud storage service.

items.pattern: a memory stick · noun + noun · also a USB stick / flash drive · on a memory stick
items.meaning: a small object you plug into a computer to save and carry files
items.example: I took my presentation to work on a **memory stick**, just in case.
more: The photographer gave us all the wedding photos on a **memory stick**.
I've lost the **memory stick** with all my recipes on it!
items.watchOut: «Флешка» — a memory stick або a USB stick (британською), a flash drive (частіше американською). «На флешці» — on a memory stick, з прийменником on.

items.pattern: a computer / laptop / app / website crashes · noun + verb · keep crashing · a crash
items.meaning: suddenly stops working, so you may lose what you were doing
items.example: The **computer crashed** just as I was paying for the tickets, so I didn't know if they were booked.
more: The online shop **crashed** on the first day of the sale because so many people were buying.
Save your work often, in case your **computer crashes**.
items.watchOut: Crash — раптово перестати працювати, часто з утратою даних. Freeze — зависнути: екран не реагує. Не плутай crash /kræʃ/ і crush /krʌʃ/ — розчавити.

warmup.uk: Я підписався на канал про подорожі.
warmup.explain: Підписатися на канал, журнал чи розсилку — subscribe to. «Підписати документ» — sign.
Уточнити пошук — refine (або narrow down) your search. Clarify — пояснити, з'ясувати.

warmup.uk: Я записую, скільки води випиваю щодня.
warmup.q: I ___ a record of how much water I drink every day.
warmup.explain: Вести облік, записувати — keep a record of sth. Lead — вести за собою, керувати: lead a team.

warmup.q: Don't forget to ___ your apps regularly.
warmup.explain: Оновити програму — update. Renew — подовжити термін дії: renew your passport. Renovate — відремонтувати будинок.

warmup.uk: Я завантажив безкоштовну гру на доньчин планшет.
warmup.q: I ___ a free game onto my daughter's tablet.
warmup.explain: Download — з інтернету на свій пристрій. Upload — навпаки, з пристрою в інтернет.
Зламати акаунт — hack (into) an account. Break і smash — зламати чи розбити фізично.

warmup.uk: Перш ніж скидати налаштування телефону, зроби резервну копію фото.
warmup.q: Before you reset your phone, ___ up your photos.
warmup.explain: Зробити резервну копію — back up (дієслово з двох слів). Save up — відкладати гроші.

warmup.uk: У ноутбука раптом стався збій, і вся моя робота пропала.
warmup.q: My laptop suddenly ___, and I lost all my work.
warmup.explain: Комп'ютер чи програма раптом перестали працювати — crashed. Fell down — упав на підлогу, hung up — поклав слухавку.

A.q: The waiter told us the wifi password, and I ___ a note of it.
A.explain: Записати, щоб не забути — make a note of sth. Do a note — калька.

A.q: Our teacher showed us how to ___ websites critically, and now I always check who wrote them.
A.explain: Критично оцінювати — evaluate sth critically. Estimate — приблизно підрахувати, appreciate — цінувати.

A.q: The magazine sells ___ issues on its website for £3 each.
A.explain: Попередні номери журналу — back issues. Свіжий номер — the latest issue.

B.q: To watch the video, ___ on the link below.
B.explain: Натиснути на посилання — click (on) a link, на телефоні — tap a link.

B.q: I took a great photo of the sunset and ___ it to Instagram straight away.
B.explain: Upload — з телефону в інтернет; download — з інтернету на телефон.

B.q: My laptop came with free anti-virus ___ for a year.
B.explain: Software незлічуване: anti-virus software, без -s. Hardware — саме «залізо»: комп'ютер, клавіатура, принтер.

topics: helping a grandparent with a new laptop
doing a school project at home
the first week at a new job
a student's first essay at university

example.title: Grandma goes online
example.uk:
Минулої весни в бабусі з'явився перший ноутбук. Я встановив антивірус і показав їй, як робити резервні копії файлів. Потім вона вирішила дослідити історію нашої родини. Я сказав їй, що почати варто з місцевої газети, яка виклала свої старі номери в інтернет. Бабуся пошукала в інтернеті наше прізвище й записала кожне ім'я, яке знайшла.

Одного ранку вона натиснула на посилання в дивному листі, і в її ноутбука стався збій. Вона дуже засмутилася, але нічого не пропало: усі її записи зберігалися в хмарному сховищі.

Тепер вона завжди перевіряє, хто надіслав лист, перш ніж відкрити вкладення.
example.en:
Last spring my grandma got her first laptop. I [[installed anti-virus software|b1]] and showed her how to [[back up her files|b8]]. Then she decided to research our family history. [[A good place to start|a1]], I told her, was the local newspaper, which had put its [[back issues|a10]] online. She [[did a web search|a3]] for our surname and [[made a note of|a2]] every name she found.

One morning she [[clicked on a link|b4]] in a strange email, and her [[laptop crashed|b12]]. She was very upset, but nothing was lost: all her notes were safe in [[cloud storage|b10]].

Now she always checks who sent a message before she [[opens an attachment|b5]].
